hotel_name: Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort and Spa

claims.text: Rooms are steps from the lifts, Beaver Creek Ski & Snowboard School, the village ice rink and the shops and restaurants of Beaver Creek Village.

findings.quote: Our 193 guest rooms and suites place you steps from the lifts, Beaver Creek Ski & Snowboard School, the village ice rink and the shops and restaurants of Beaver Creek Village.
findings.note: rooms page states all listed proximities

claims.text: Exhale Spa offers massages, facials and body treatments, plus access to the resort fitness classes.

findings.quote: Offering complete wellness options including massages, facials, and body treatments, plus access to the resort fitness classes

claims.text: The resort has an outdoor heated swimming pool.

findings.quote: soak in the warm sunshine from our outdoor, heated swimming pool

claims.text: 8100 Mountainside has a heated patio with views of the ski base and valley.

findings.quote: 8100 Mountainside bar and grill offers delectable breakfast and dinner options to energize your day and a spacious heated patio boasting luxurious views of the ski base and valley.
findings.note: heated patio with ski base and valley views

claims.text: Brass Bear Bar features a grand fireplace and a selection of cocktails and bar bites.

findings.quote: the bar features a grand fireplace, elegant seating, and a delicious selection of cocktails and bar bites.

claims.text: Fall Line Market is a 24-hour market stocked with salads, sandwiches, pastries, coffee and espresso.

findings.quote: Fall Line Market is a 24-hour Epicurean Market stocked with salads, sandwiches, pastries, hot coffee and espresso.

claims.text: The on-site ski rental and shop is inside the resort, between the ski slopes and the Village ice rink.

findings.quote: Located inside our resort, the store is easy to find, nestled between our Colorado ski slopes and the Village ice rink.

claims.text: The One King Park Junior Suite has an electric fireplace that is functional for fall and winter seasons.

findings.quote: An elegant electric fireplace is functional for fall and winter seasons.
findings.note: stated in One King Park Junior Suite with Fireplace description

claims.text: Rooms have Le Labo bath amenities.
The resort fee includes indoor and outdoor games including a family arcade, table tennis, cornhole and family board games.

findings.quote: Indoor and outdoor games and activities including family arcade, table tennis, cornhole and family board games

claims.text: The resort fee includes guided hikes on Beaver Creek Mountain.

findings.quote: Guided hikes on Beaver Creek Mountain

claims.text: Up to two dogs weighing up to 70 pounds each are welcome per room or suite, with a one-time nonrefundable $200 fee.

findings.quote: We welcome two dogs weighing up to 70 pounds each per room or suite. A one-time nonrefundable $200 fee applies.

claims.text: The renovation of the resort's guest rooms and suites is complete, with renovated rooms available for stays starting October 2025.

findings.quote: We are thrilled to announce the completed renovation of our resort guest rooms and suites. Now available for stays starting October 2025

claims.text: Brass Bear Bar has floor-to-ceiling views of the Beaver Creek mountains.

findings.quote: Brass Bear Bar is the hub of activity year-round, with floor-to-ceiling views of the soaring Beaver Creek mountains

claims.text: 8100 Mountainside is named for the 8,100 ft. base elevation of Beaver Creek.

findings.quote: Named for its prime location at the 8,100 ft. base elevation of Beaver Creek

claims.text: The pool area has five hot tubs and cabanas that can be reserved.

findings.quote: Relax in one of five hot tubs, reserve a cabana or lie back on one of the many pool chairs
findings.note: five hot tubs and reservable cabanas

claims.text: The resort holds seasonal culinary events including Chef's Table dining and a Raclette experience.

findings.quote: Discover seasonal and indulgent culinary events including Chef's Table dining, Raclette experience, beverages tastings and more.

claims.text: A daily resort fee of $60.00, subject to change, applies to each room.

findings.quote: A daily resort fee of $60.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

claims.text: The resort has partnered exclusively with SnowCountry for guest transportation to and from Eagle County Regional Airport.

findings.quote: Park Hyatt Beaver Creek Resort & Spa has partnered exclusively with SnowCountry for all guest transportation needs to and from Eagle County Regional Airport (EGE).

claims.text: WhataHotel notes peak winter rates during ski season.
